question: Which athlete set a new American outdoor record in the men's 5000 m with a time of 12 : 45.27?
solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Nico Young**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nico Young** is a prominent **American** long-distance runner who rose to fame competing for **Northern Arizona University (NAU)**. In **2024**, he transitioned to a **professional** career by signing with **Adidas**.
 
• The athlete has been instrumental in redefining **American** distance running benchmarks. The time of **12:45.27** represents an elite performance in the **men's 5,000 m**, a distance that requires **12.5 laps** of a standard **400 m** outdoor track.
 
• Born on **July 27, 2002**, in **Camarillo, California**, **Nico Young** became the first collegiate athlete to break the **13-minute** barrier in the **5,000 m**, setting an **NCAA** record of **12:57.14** earlier in **2024** before pushing toward the **national** record.
 
• His training base in **Flagstaff, Arizona**, which sits at an elevation of approximately **7,000 feet**, is widely credited for his exceptional cardiovascular endurance and ability to compete against the world's best **East African** runners.
 
• At the **2024 U.S. Olympic Team Trials** held in **Eugene, Oregon**, **Nico Young** demonstrated his elite status by qualifying for the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games** in both the **5,000 m** and **10,000 m** events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Grant Fisher**: 
 
 
• Prior to recent surges in times, **Grant Fisher** held the **American outdoor record** for the **5,000 m** with a time of **12:46.96**, set in **September 2022** at the **Diamond League** final in **Zurich**.
 
• **Fisher** is a **Stanford University** alumnus and a **Tokyo 2020** Olympian who has consistently lowered the **U.S.** records across multiple distances.
 
 
 
• **Yared Nuguse**: 
 
 
• **Yared Nuguse** is primarily celebrated as a middle-distance specialist. He holds the **American record** in the **mile** with a time of **3:43.97** and the **3,000 m** indoors.
 
• He represents **On Athletics Club (OAC)** and is known for his tactical racing and powerful "kick" in the final **400 meters**.
 
 
 
• **Cole Hocker**: 
 
 
• **Cole Hocker** is a standout **1,500 m** runner who won the **2024 U.S. Olympic Trials** in that event with a meet record of **3:30.59**.
 
• His versatility allows him to compete at a high level in the **5,000 m**, often utilizing his speed developed in shorter races to out-sprint opponents.
 
 
 
• **The 5,000 m Event**: 
 
 
• The **5,000 m** (approximately **3.1 miles**) is a standard **Olympic** distance. The world record is held by **Joshua Cheptegei** of **Uganda** with a time of **12:35.36** set in **2020**.
 
• Modern advancements in footwear technology, often called "**super spikes**," and the use of **Wavelight** technology (pacing lights on the track) have contributed to significantly faster times in the **2020s**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Professional Transition**: **Nico Young**’s decision to turn **professional** in **June 2024** followed one of the most successful **collegiate** seasons in history, including multiple **NCAA Division I** titles.
 
• **Olympic Qualification**: The **United States** long-distance squad for the **Paris 2024** games is considered one of the strongest in history, with athletes like **Young** and **Fisher** both capable of challenging for podium spots.
 
• **Record Progression**: The **American** record for the **5,000 m** has seen a rapid progression; it took over **13 years** to break the **12:54** mark set by **Bernard Lagat** in **2011**, but multiple athletes have since surpassed it.
